texts.preamble: Bhushan S/O Deoraoji Chikte vs State Of Mah., Thr. Pso Ps Khapa Dist ... on 1 July, 2019 Author: Manish Pitale Bench: Manish Pitale 1/2 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Nagpur Bench, Nagpur. Cri. Appln. (Aba) No. 417 Of 2019 Bhushan Deoraoji Chikte and another -Vs.- State of Mah., thr.PSO, Ps Khapa, District Nagpur ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Office notes, Office Memoranda of Coram, appearances, Court's orders Court's or Judge' or directions and Registrar's orders. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Mr.A.A.Dhawas, Advocate for the applicants. Coram : Manish Pitale, J. Date : 01.07.2019. Heard learned counsel for the applicants.
texts.facts: 4. The applicants herein are apprehending their arrest in respect of FIR dated 16/05/2019, registered against them for the offences punishable under sections 272, 273, 328 of IPC and section 59 of the Food Safety Standard Act, 2006. 5. The allegation against the applicants is that gutka, which is a banned substance in the State of Maharashtra was being transported in a vehicle belonging to the applicant No.1 and that it was being transported in the vehicle by the applicants. The FIR shows that the said material worth Rs.60,000/- was recovered from the said vehicle KHUNTE aba417.19.odt and that the gutka as well as the said vehicle were seized. It is pointed out by the learned counsel for the applicants that they do not have any criminal antecedents and that they are ready to cooperate with the investigation. 2. In the present case seeking pre-arrest bail since they are apprehending arrest in connection with Crime No.134/2019 register with Khapa Police Station, District Nagpur for offen Section 59 of the Food Safety Standards Act, 2006 an Sections 272, 273, and 328 of the Indian Penal Code. On 1.7.2019, present applicants were released on ad interim anticipatory bail on condition that they shall cooperate with Investigating Officer and shall be available to Investigating Officer as and when they are required. 5. Even, according to the prosecution, the contraband is already seized and present applicants attended the police station and joined investigation. 6 . During the course of hearing, learned counsel Shri A.A.Dhawas for applicants, volunteered that applicant No.1-Bhushan s/o Deoraoji Chikte will deposit Rs.60,000/- in the Court of learned Magistrate, Saoner within a period of two weeks from today.
